concerns.text: Task T010 [P] [US1] depends on the schema created by T015_schema_create, but T015_schema_create is listed later in the file. This violates the producer‑before‑consumer rule; the schema must be generated before any task that consumes it (e.g., T010, T012).

Task T012 [US1] depends on T015_schema_create (schema) but the schema task appears after T012. Move T015_schema_create earlier so that the schema exists before ingestion and featurization tasks that validate against it.
